subject: Public Comments Form
comment: St George used to have the best 4th of July celebration around! Today on the 4th of July? we went to the park... nothing! They canceled everything! We asked the man at carnival booth what happened, he didn't know. There were other families there that were also wondering what happened. One drove from Las Vegas to participate. Just wondering why the city of St. George would cancel the best 4th of July celebration around?
